extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.intro: Extensions add features to Meshloom and only do what you allow them to.
extensions.empty: No extension installed yet. Add a bundled extension to get started.

tabs.storeSoon: The Store is not available yet.

config_required.text: This extension needs some settings before it can start. It stays off until they are filled in.

review_permissions.text: This extension asks for different permissions than before. Review them below, then accept to start it.

privacy_widened.text: This update uses your data more widely. Review it below, then accept to start it.

review_permissions_privacy.text: This update asks for other permissions and uses your data more widely. Review, then accept.

consent_required.text: This extension needs your consent for the permissions below before it can start.

migrated.text: This extension comes from a converted bot. Review what it can do, then accept to start it.

restored.text: Restored extension, turned off. Check it below, then accept to start it.

reinstall.text: Restored without its code: reinstall or uninstall it.
reinstall.unavailable: Restored without its code, and its source is not available here. You can uninstall it.

config_dropped.text: The update reset some settings: {{fields}}. Check them and save.

other.text: This extension waits for you to review it before it can start.

blocked.revoked: This extension was revoked and cannot be started. Uninstall it.
blocked.incompatible: Not compatible with this Meshloom version: uninstall it or wait for an update.

enableBlocked.review: Open it to review and accept

explain.bwrap: Each extension runs in a sandbox, with no access to other files.
explain.setuid: Each extension runs under a dedicated system account that cannot read Meshloom's files.
explain.none: No sandbox here: an extension could read your data. Only install extensions you trust.
explain.unknown: The isolation level is reported once the server has started the extension system.

purgeBlocked.title: A temporary folder keeps extension accounts taken
purgeBlocked.text: Meshloom could not clean the temporary folders of removed extensions, so these accounts stay reserved:
purgeBlocked.fix: On the server, remove these folders or make them readable (chmod o+r), then restart Meshloom.
purgeBlocked.leaseFix: Another Meshloom on this machine holds this account. If it no longer runs, delete this file from .meshloom-plugin-uids, then restart Meshloom.

disabled.env: Extensions are turned off by this server's host. You can only view and uninstall them.
disabled.platform: Extensions are not available on this platform. You can only view and uninstall them.
disabled.isolation: Extensions are stopped: their isolation could not be set up. You can only view and uninstall them.
disabled.drawer: Extensions are turned off on this server: nothing here can be changed or started.

add.title: Add a bundled extension
add.intro: These extensions ship with Meshloom and install without internet access.
add.none: No bundled extension is available in this version.
add.consentIntro: This extension will be able to do the following. You can lower these permissions later.
add.accept: I understand what this extension can do and I allow it.

privacy.title: Privacy declaration
privacy.storesNone: Does not keep the content of messages.

scope.except: All conversations except the ones I pick

drawer.notice_permission_dropped_supervisor: Permission cut: it targets Home Assistant's internal network, off limits to extensions. Remove that address to restore it.
drawer.permissionsHint: Untick a permission to take it away. An extension cannot be given more than it declares.
drawer.quotasHint: You can only lower these limits, never raise them above what the extension asks for.
drawer.quotaInvalid: Enter whole numbers from 1 to {{hour}} per hour and from 1 to {{day}} per day.
drawer.reinstalled: Reinstalled. Check it, then accept to start it.

logs.title: Logs
logs.failed: The log could not be read.
logs.truncated: Showing the most recent lines only.

uninstall.title: Uninstall {{name}}?
uninstall.text: The extension stops and its settings and secrets are deleted.
uninstall.keepData: Keep its data and secrets: restored if you reinstall it from the same source, deleted after 90 days.

migration.title: Your bots were converted to extensions
migration.text: Review each converted extension: it only starts once you accept.
migration.bannerText_one: {{count}} bot was converted into an extension and awaits your review.
migration.bannerText_other: {{count}} bots were converted into extensions and await your review.

extensions.memberReadOnly: Only an administrator can manage extensions.
extensions.drawerMemberReadOnly: Only an administrator can change, restart or uninstall this extension, or read its log.

pause.hint: Stops every extension at once, until you resume.
pause.confirmText: Every extension stops, even across a restart, until you resume. They will not get the messages that arrive meanwhile.
pause.banner: All extensions are paused since {{time}} by {{user}}.
pause.bannerUnreadable: The pause state cannot be read: extensions stay stopped until an administrator resumes them.
pause.bannerExplain: None runs and none receives messages. Changes are saved and apply on resume.

store.title: Custom repositories
store.intro: Add an extension published on GitHub, as owner/name.
store.warning: Custom repositories are neither reviewed nor signed by Meshloom: install them at your own risk.
store.offline: The Store is off: nothing is fetched from GitHub until you turn it back on above.
store.removeIntro: Extensions already installed stay, but their updates are no longer checked.
store.accept: I understand this plugin is not reviewed or signed by Meshloom, and I accept these permissions.
store.adminOnly: Only an administrator can see and manage custom repositories.

warnings.plugins_restored: {{value}} extension(s) restored turned off: accept each one in Settings > Extensions.
warnings.plugins_to_reinstall: {{value}} extension(s) to reinstall from Settings > Extensions.
warnings.plugin_secrets_missing: {{value}} extension(s) need their secrets: type them in their settings.
warnings.plugin_dropped: An extension of the backup ({{value}}) could not be restored and was left out.
warnings.plugin_dropped_supervisor: Extension {{value}} not restored: it targets Home Assistant's internal network.
warnings.plugin_kept: The extension {{value}} is already installed here: it was kept as it is.
